architecture.pattern: Clean Architecture with Event-Driven IPC Service & Unidirectional Data Flow (MVI/MVVM)
layers: Presentation Layer: Accessible Android Activity & WebView UI with W3C WAI-ARIA 1.3 live announcements for TalkBack and Jieshuo
Bridge & IPC Layer: Local RFC 6455 WebSocket Server (127.0.0.1:8765) & Termux RUN_COMMAND Intent Dispatcher with PendingIntent callback capture
Automation & Accessibility Layer: Android AccessibilityService (API 34) managing active window node inspection, gesture dispatching, screenshot capture, and node action execution
Domain & Security Layer: Loopback socket binding, permission validation (com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND, BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE), and rate-limited command execution
architecture.a11y_strategy: Strict compliance with WCAG 2.2 AAA & W3C WAI-ARIA. Direct screen reader integration for TalkBack & CSR/Jieshuo. Zero emoji clutter. All custom UI components declared with explicit semantic roles, focusable tabindex, and aria-live="polite" status regions. Dynamic event narration for active window changes and Termux command execution results.
architecture.persistence: EncryptedSharedPreferences / DataStore for bridge port configuration, allowed command whitelists, and local IPC auth tokens

requirements.title: Android Accessibility Service Core Implementation
requirements.description: Implement AntigravityAccessibilityService extending AccessibilityService with android:canRetrieveWindowContent="true", android:canPerformGestures="true", and android:canTakeScreenshot="true". Provide getRootInActiveWindow() and getRootInActiveWindow_prefetching(int) for low-latency hierarchy traversal, performAction(int, Bundle) on AccessibilityNodeInfo, performGlobalAction(int) for system navigation, and dispatchGesture(GestureDescription, GestureResultCallback, Handler) for tactile gesture dispatching.
requirements.verification_criteria: Service successfully binds, connects via onServiceConnected(), dumps hierarchy node tree without ANR, and dispatches back/home/recents global actions.

requirements.title: Termux RUN_COMMAND Intent Integration
requirements.description: Implement TermuxBridgeManager adhering to com.termux.RUN_COMMAND specifications. Dispatch explicit intents to com.termux/com.termux.app.RunCommandService with EXTRA_COMMAND_PATH, EXTRA_ARGUMENTS, EXTRA_WORKDIR, and EXTRA_BACKGROUND=true. Attach PendingIntent with FLAG_MUTABLE (API 31+) to capture asynchronous execution results (stdout, stderr, exitCode, errCode) without payload truncation.
requirements.verification_criteria: Successful round-trip command execution in Termux background, returning exitCode 0 and captured stdout back to the companion app.

requirements.title: Local Duplex WebSocket IPC Server
requirements.description: Embed Java-WebSocket WebSocketServer bound exclusively to 127.0.0.1:8765 running in a dedicated background executor thread. Provide real-time bidirectional JSON-RPC messaging between Termux Python/CLI agents and the companion Android app. Support actions: ping, get_window_tree, click_node, input_text, swipe, take_screenshot, and run_termux_command.
requirements.verification_criteria: WebSocket client in Termux connects to ws://127.0.0.1:8765, sends get_window_tree command, and receives complete JSON hierarchy.

requirements.title: Accessible Companion UI & WebView ARIA Integration
requirements.description: Build MainActivity with integrated WebView adhering to W3C WAI-ARIA and TalkBack/Jieshuo standards. WebSettings configured with JavaScript enabled and safe JavascriptInterface bridge (window.AntigravityBridge). Dynamic logs and service statuses stream to aria-live="polite" container with accessible names, clear keyboard navigation, and zero decorative emoji noise.
requirements.verification_criteria: TalkBack and Jieshuo read status updates cleanly without focus trapping, and JavascriptInterface calls trigger Android bridge actions safely.

requirements.title: Low-Latency Screenshot Acquisition
requirements.description: Implement takeScreenshot(DEFAULT_DISPLAY, Executor, TakeScreenshotCallback) available on API 30+ to capture screen buffers for vision-language models and CLI OCR agents without requiring MediaProjection permissions or root access.
requirements.verification_criteria: Screenshot callback returns valid HardwareBuffer, converted to JPEG/PNG bytes and transmitted via WebSocket or written to shared cache.

requirements.title: Self-Diagnostic Doctor & Health Check Engine
requirements.description: Provide internal DoctorDiagnosticEngine verifying: (1) Accessibility Service enablement status, (2) com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND grant status, (3) ~/.termux/termux.properties allow-external-apps flag, (4) WebSocket server port 8765 availability, and (5) TalkBack/Jieshuo active accessibility services.
requirements.verification_criteria: Diagnostic returns structured JSON report with actionable 3-part remediation instructions for any missing permission or misconfiguration.

requirements.title: Graceful Lifecycle Management & Signal Handling
requirements.description: Ensure AntigravityAccessibilityService and WebSocketServer handle lifecycle events (onDestroy, onUnbind, configuration changes) gracefully. Stop socket listeners, release active node references, clear PendingIntent receivers, and flush pending log buffers atomically.
requirements.verification_criteria: Zero memory leaks, socket address-in-use collisions on restart, or orphan background threads.

requirements.title: GitHub Actions Automated APK Build & Release Workflow
requirements.description: Provide .github/workflows/build-apk.yml configuring an Ubuntu runner with JDK 17, Android SDK Platform 34, and Gradle to automatically compile app-debug.apk and app-release.apk on push or workflow_dispatch, publishing downloadable APK artifacts to GitHub Releases.
requirements.verification_criteria: GitHub Actions workflow YAML syntax is valid and builds APK artifact without needing local Android SDK in Termux.

entry_points.run: ./gradlew installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.antigravity.companion/.MainActivity
